title: ODH Component Details
description: Input parameters for onboarding an ODH/RHOAI component onto the Konflux CI/build platform

product_context.description: Target product platform for this component

component_name.description: Unique component name starting with 'odh-', using only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Must not end with '-rhel9' or a version-like suffix such as -v2, -3-4, -v3-4, or -v3-5-ea-1; onboarding automation appends the RHOAI version itself.

repo_url.description: Full HTTPS URL of the component's GitHub repository

context_path.description: Docker build context path relative to the repo root (use ./ for root)

dockerfile_path.description: Path to the Dockerfile relative to the context path

build_type.description: Onboarding target: CI pipeline or Release pipeline (required when product_context is ODH)

odh_release_tag.description: Version tag for ODH Release builds (e.g. 2.21.0). Required when product_context is ODH and build_type is Release.

architectures.description: Target CPU architectures to build for (required when product_context is RHOAI)

target_rhoai_version.description: Target RHOAI release version in canonical form x.y or x.y-ea-n (required when product_context is RHOAI)

is_operator.description: Whether the component is an operator or controller; controls whether operator manifest paths are required

operator_manifest_src_path.description: Relative path to component manifests within the git repo (required when is_operator is true)

operator_manifest_dest_path.description: Destination path in the odh-operator container image where manifests are copied (required when is_operator is true)

long_description.description: One or two sentences describing what the component does (required when product_context is RHOAI)

short_description.description: A short noun phrase of a few words summarising the component (required when product_context is RHOAI)

release_category.description: Release maturity category for the component (required when product_context is RHOAI)
